release_notes: Buyer Log 7.0.193 TEST: PLM sample status is robust to confusing PLM entries — if a sample type has an approved request, later unapproved re-entries (Evaluated / Received) are ignored, and an approved Sample Evaluation Status also counts as approval. Sample stage order: Fit and S/Off run independently; S/Off (artwork print/embroidery approval) also approves Artwork; PPS is the final stage and also approves Fit, S/Off and Artwork. Orders that have finished production (loading, shortage, in transit, customs, warehouse, awaiting retail transfer) or have any shipped quantity are treated as sample-approved (single "Approved · Post-production" badge in the CP PLM Numune column; checklist sample questions close). New built-in Priority rule: PPS not approved within 21 days of Ex-factory (threshold editable in the rule editor). Opening CP refreshes stale (24h+) sample data for in-production orders in the background. Fixed: the status "Customs & Port Operations" was not recognised as the customs stage.
